route: ordinary --headless host serving bundled UI over loopback; isolated temporary APPDATA
method: Real browser clicks/fill/select/check actions; read-only public InspectManager intents verify committed state. No mocked transport or direct backend authoring.
initial_observer_failure: Exact tab-name locator omitted the accessible close-button name; timed out before authoring. Kernel reset closed that browser, verified absent before starting its replacement. Corrected locator uses observed tab text. Host was retained.
assertion_observation: Node REPL cross-realm prototypes caused strict comparison of structurally equal JSON to fail. Normalized both operands as JSON and verified the original committed values without repeating authoring.

checks.case: Default empty Media Manager and module registration
Create Solid Color, Picture and Shared Texture through UI controls
Rename Solid media and Primary/Secondary channels with stable references
Add/select/reorder channels; retain Primary defaults while Secondary becomes fixed 320x180, Nearest, straight linear RGBA [0.25,0.5,0.75,0.5]
Delete selected Secondary; last-channel delete disabled; one UI undo restores original references and order
Picture import/assign gate50/a.png; relink gate50/b.png with stable asset/channel IDs; clear and reselect catalog asset
Spout A exact selector, admitted RGBA8/Linear/Premultiplied 4x4, fixed 64x32, Nearest; all committed values match backend inspection
Add independent Spout B; change then clear A; B's full committed channel remains identical
Delete Picture media while retaining its shared asset and unrelated Shared Texture; undo restores exact media/channel/source identity
Top-level atomic absolute-path Picture import creates asset/media/channel; one UI undo restores exact preceding catalog
Refresh and browser reload retain exact backend catalog, three media and one asset
Rendered catalog/channel editor uses wrapped controls and vertical panel scrolling; browser shows Preview unavailable

limits: Host locators are intentionally missing files; this checks authoring, not decoding or pixels. Source pixels/lifecycle are qualified by M04 gates 2-4.
Browser route has no native preview, file dialog or discovered-sender picker. No native picker/discovery widget interaction or desktop preview input is inferred.
Browser reload is not engine project reload; complete cross-source UI/script/headless and host-mode intent parity remains M04 gate 6.
No performance, physical-display or other phase acceptance is inferred.
